baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verb at word 2 governs the deictic prepositional phrase ending in the city at word 4, while the initial negation remains a live pressure on the oath construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: Oath-taking recruits a specifically bounded tract as witness and evidentiary ground. The utterance is therefore spatially indexed rather than a generic intensifier, although the force of the initial negation remains unresolved.

activation_trace.role: Supplies oath-taking as a bond apportioned among its holders and makes the verb a performative act of witness.
Supplies a bounded tract of land and makes the deictic city the oath's delimited evidentiary field.

changed_reading.before: A conventional emphatic oath mentioning a city.
changed_reading.after: A speech act that makes this delimited place itself the ground of testimony, with the opening negation still capable of checking, suspending, or intensifying that act.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two lexical roots at words 2 and 4 can be read together as division or allotment acting upon a bounded inhabited place.
baseline_models.mechanism: The oath root also carries the separation of shares, while the city root carries both territorial limit and settled residence. Their contact overlays the city with an allotment map: a place whose boundary separates shares, claims, or responsibilities.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the separation and apportionment of shares and turns the verbal root into a latent territorial operation.
Supplies a delimited tract and gives the apportioning operation a spatial field.
Supplies residence and attachment to the place, so the latent shares can concern inhabitants rather than geometry alone.

changed_reading.before: The city is merely the object named in an oath.
changed_reading.after: The wording also presents the city as an allotted and inhabited field in which boundaries distribute claims, portions, and obligations.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The city noun at word 4 has a bodily branch referring to the chest and front hollow, directly inside the oath construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: The place can be carried as an embodied front or chest: not a lexical replacement for city, but a corporeal overlay in which an oath is sworn by the vulnerable, forward-facing center of a civic body.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the oath bond and directs solemn attention toward the bodily-place image that follows.
Supplies the chest and front hollow and permits the bounded city to be imaged as an exposed civic body.

changed_reading.before: The oath concerns an external geographic location.
changed_reading.after: The oath may simultaneously face the city as a chest-like civic body, a vulnerable center that can later acquire organs, strain, and a neck.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The initial negation interrupts a verb whose root can describe a mind divided among possible courses; the city root can independently evoke perplexity and collapse of composure.
baseline_models.mechanism: A branch-distant but focus-internal reading hears the opening as a refusal to remain in fractured estimation. The utterance arrests divided judgment in a place of confusion before any context decides whether it becomes oath, denial, or correction.

activation_trace.role: Supplies a mind divided among courses and makes the negated verb an interruption of hesitant estimation.
Supplies perplexity and loss of composure and gives the interrupted judgment an affective setting.

changed_reading.before: The initial negation is flattened into a conventional oath particle.
changed_reading.after: The negation can remain dramatic: it cuts across divided, perplexed judgment even while the oath reading continues to coexist.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate repetition of the same city introduces images of untying, occupying, lifted prohibition, and release from an oath. The opening oath and the city's boundary now behave like a reversible bind: the addressee's presence can inhabit, loosen, or alter the force of the bounded jurisdiction.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the oath as a binding performative whose force can be tested by the following release images.
Supplies the original bounded tract against which occupation and loosening become spatially consequential.
Supplies the literal untying of a knot and recasts the oath-place relation as something that can be loosened.
Supplies settling in a place and makes the addressee's presence inside the boundary operational.
Supplies dissolution of a prohibition and gives the repeated city a changing legal status.
Supplies release or discharge from an oath and directly feeds back upon the opening oath mechanism.
Repeats the same bounded tract and holds the spatial referent steady while its relation to the addressee changes.

structural_cues: 90:2 immediately repeats the deictic city, preserving the same spatial object while inserting the addressed person's status within it.
The sequence moves from an oath by the boundary to a second-person relation inside that boundary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies oath, bounded place, untying, occupancy, lifted prohibition, and oath-release; I infer that the addressee's presence makes the boundary a reversible bind. A live alternative is that the second ayah merely predicates a status and does not act back on the opening oath.

changed_reading.before: The speaker simply swears by a stable city.
changed_reading.after: The oath stands at a legal-spatial threshold: this city binds and is also being unbound in relation to the addressee, so the initial negation may register suspension or reversal as well as emphasis.

context_deltas.mechanism: The move from repeated place to parent and offspring makes the bounded allotment temporally productive. The city can be read not only as inherited ground but as a generator of successive inhabitants, claims, and consequences.

activation_trace.role: Supplies shares and allotment and lets generation distribute place and obligation through time.
Supplies the bounded territorial container within which generational succession can be imagined.
Supplies the event of birth and changes the place from static boundary into a site of temporal emergence.
Supplies something produced from something else and makes civic inheritance a generative chain rather than mere occupancy.

structural_cues: The context moves from place in 90:1-2 to paired begetter and begotten in 90:3.
The root occurs twice in one compact relation, foregrounding succession rather than an isolated individual.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a bounded allotment and a parent-product sequence; I infer that place mediates intergenerational shares and consequences. The live alternative is simple coordination of separate oath objects with no causal role for the city.

changed_reading.before: The city is a fixed location honored in the present.
changed_reading.after: The city also becomes an inherited allotment that generates and receives successive lives, making the oath temporally civic rather than only geographic.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus-root image of the city as chest gathers a later center under strain, eyes, tongue, lips, and neck. Together they produce a scale analogy in which the bounded place is a civic body capable of suffering, seeing, speaking, and being released.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the chest and front hollow and anchors the later anatomy directly in the city noun.
Supplies the solemn oath bond and makes the emergent civic body an object of testimony.
Supplies hardship and struggle and places strain inside the embodied-place model.
Supplies a thing's center or heart and links the human's condition to the city's chest-like center.
Supplies the seeing eye and gives the civic body an organ of witness.
Supplies the speaking tongue and gives the civic body an organ for testimony and counsel.
Supplies the lips and completes the speaking and feeding threshold of the civic body.
Supplies the neck and turns later release into an operation upon the same distributed body.

structural_cues: A concentrated body-part sequence in 90:8-9 follows the human placed in a center of hardship and precedes the neck in 90:13.
The singular deictic city and singular human permit a scale analogy without requiring lexical identity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the city's chest branch and later images of center, organs, and neck; I compose them into one civic anatomy. The materially live alternative is that every body image concerns the human alone and never feeds back into the place noun.

changed_reading.before: The oath points outward to urban geography.
changed_reading.after: The oath can also point to a civic organism: its center bears strain, its eyes witness, its mouth speaks, and its neck becomes the site where bondage can be undone.

context_deltas.mechanism: The legal oath and latent apportionment of the focus are followed by counting, limit or power, a spoken expenditure claim, wealth piled in layers, and seeing. The city becomes a jurisdiction of public account in which boasts about consumed resources are measured against power and witness.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the oath's legal and testimonial frame and opens the later claim to adjudication.
Supplies apportioned shares and makes the claimed wealth susceptible to distributional accounting.
Supplies a bounded jurisdiction within which account, power, and witness can converge.
Supplies counting and reckoning and turns the interrogative thought into an audit operation.
Supplies a measure reaching its limit and gives the audit a scale against which claims are bounded.
Supplies an uttered statement and identifies the wealth expenditure as a claim rather than self-validating fact.
Supplies exhaustion or consumption of effort and sharpens what the speaker alleges was spent.
Supplies acquisition and abundance of wealth and provides the audit's material object.
Supplies accumulated layers or masses and gives the boast its asserted magnitude.
Supplies sight by eye and insight and closes the account under an observing witness.

structural_cues: The repeated interrogative about what the person supposes brackets the expenditure boast in 90:5-7.
The first question concerns reach or power, the middle gives a monetary claim, and the second concerns being seen.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies legal oath, apportioned shares, calculation, measure, speech, consumed effort, piled wealth, and sight; I infer a public accounting sequence located by the city. A live alternative is a universal moral interrogation with no specifically civic or forensic mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The city is honored before an unrelated rebuke of human arrogance.
changed_reading.after: The oath opens a civic court of account: within this boundary, asserted expenditure is counted, limited, and seen rather than accepted at the scale claimed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus-root image of territorial partition becomes a map when two elevated ways are disclosed and a difficult rise must be entered. The split mapping for guidance preserves two coexisting route experiences: gentle indication toward a way and a hard descent or threatening terrain.

activation_trace.role: Supplies division into shares and converts the bounded place into a field that can branch into routes.
Supplies the bounded terrain on which route partition and traversal can occur.
Supplies gentle indication toward a path or truth and yields the disclosed-map reading.
Supplies a difficult descent from the non-dominant mapped root and keeps a harsher route experience alive beside gentle guidance.
Supplies elevation and gives the two routes visible topographic relief.
Supplies severity and distress and prevents the elevated routes from becoming neutral scenery.
Supplies perilous entry into road difficulties and turns seeing a route into the demand to traverse it.
Supplies a difficult rising obstacle and gives the mapped choice a concrete cost.

structural_cues: The explicit dual of the two elevated ways follows paired eyes and paired lips, reinforcing a visible bifurcation.
90:11 immediately changes disclosed topography into failed traversal, and 90:12 repeats the obstacle.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies territorial division, gentle path-indication, a non-dominant difficult descent, elevation, distress, perilous entry, and a hard rise; I infer that the opening city doubles as decision terrain. The two mapped guidance roots remain alternative activations, not merged lexical senses.

changed_reading.before: The city is a stationary object of the oath.
changed_reading.after: The city becomes a partitioned route-map whose ways can be gently disclosed yet bodily experienced as descent, height, and difficult ascent; those readings remain in tension.

context_deltas.mechanism: The latent shares of the bounded inhabited place become concrete transfers: opening what is locked around a neck, feeding amid exhausting hunger, supporting a child cut off from a guardian but joined by kinship, and raising one abased against the ground. Civic boundary now creates proximity and distributive responsibility.

activation_trace.role: Supplies apportioned shares and makes release and food changes in who controls or receives a portion.
Supplies residence and attachment to place and grounds the later obligations among co-present inhabitants.
Supplies release of a pledged or captive neck from constraint and turns the difficult route into an unbinding act.
Supplies the literal neck or person and gives the release a bodily and social object.
Supplies feeding another and converts wealth from a claimed loss into provision received by someone else.
Supplies hunger joined to exhaustion and makes the transfer responsive to acute material pressure.
Supplies a child cut off from a guardian and identifies a broken protective relation the civic share can repair.
Supplies kinship and turns spatial nearness into a particular relational claim.
Supplies abasement associated with destitution and marks the recipient's constrained social motion.
Supplies poverty figured as adhesion to dust and brings the city's distributive field down to ground level.

structural_cues: 90:13-16 specify the difficult rise through a sequence of release and provision rather than through private ascent.
The sequence crosses legal constraint, bodily hunger, broken guardianship, kinship, social abasement, and literal ground contact.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shares, residence, unbinding, a neck, feeding, hunger, interrupted guardianship, kinship, abasement, and dust-poverty; I infer that the city's allotments are tested by transfers toward its most constrained members. The live alternative is that these acts are universal duties with no city-specific distributive frame.

changed_reading.before: The oath sacralizes a place independently of what happens within it.
changed_reading.after: The oath weighs the city as a distribution field: its boundary matters because shares can remain locked and accumulated or be released as freedom, food, guardianship, and restored standing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus inventory's oath apportioned among holders meets reciprocal counsel, bearing a guarantee, mercy, kinship, and companionship. The initially singular speech act can therefore propagate as a civic covenant repeatedly carried by members of a community.

activation_trace.role: Supplies an oath apportioned among holders and enables the opening bond to become communally distributed.
Supplies settled residence and gives the distributed bond a civic population.
Supplies exchanged counsel among a group and provides the replication mechanism for the oath-like bond.
Supplies bearing a guarantee and remaining attached, giving the mutual bond durable obligation.
Supplies tenderness and mercy and determines the bond's affective direction.
Supplies kinship and extends the earlier familial claim into communal relation.
Supplies companionship and sustained association and names the collective produced by mutual obligation.

structural_cues: 90:17 repeats the reciprocal counsel construction twice, making transmission between people more salient than solitary possession.
90:18 immediately redescribes the resulting people as companions of one side.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an oath distributed among holders, reciprocal counsel, guarantee-bearing, mercy, kinship, and companionship; I infer that the opening bond is socially retransmitted among residents. A live alternative keeps the opening oath solely with its speaker and treats later reciprocity as an independent ethic.

changed_reading.before: One speaker performs an oath over a city.
changed_reading.after: The oath can inaugurate a civic bond whose burden is apportioned, repeated, and kept through mutual counsel, endurance, mercy, and companionship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's division and bounded-place images culminate in two companion groups marked by right and left, visible signs either received or covered, and a final enclosure shut around one group. The city can thus function as a sorting boundary rather than only the honored object of an oath.

activation_trace.role: Supplies separation into shares and anchors the later right-left grouping in the opening verbal root.
Supplies the enclosing spatial boundary within which sorting and closure can be modeled.
Supplies sustained companionship and makes the first side a durable association rather than a momentary position.
Supplies the right hand or rightward side and gives the first group a spatial orientation.
Supplies covering and makes refusal operate as occlusion inside the sorting mechanism.
Supplies a visible sign and establishes what the covering prevents from functioning as evidence.
Repeats durable companionship and symmetrically forms the second group.
Supplies the leftward side and completes the spatial opposition.
Supplies kindled fire and marks the condition imposed upon the enclosed side.
Supplies closing something over what is inside and turns the final boundary into containment.
Supplies the non-dominant mapped image of a door tightly shut and sharpens containment into sealed access.

structural_cues: The same companionship label appears in adjacent ayat for opposed right and left groups.
The sequence visible sign, covering, left-side companionship, fire, and closure moves from evidence to classification to enclosure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies division, bounded place, paired companion groups, right and left, visible signs, covering, fire, and two mapped closure images; I infer that the opening place functions as a sorting enclosure. A live alternative treats the sides as outcomes unrelated to the city's boundary.

changed_reading.before: The oath honors a city before a later binary conclusion.
changed_reading.after: The oath can introduce a bounded sorting field: companionship is apportioned to opposed sides, evidence may be covered, and one partition ultimately closes over its occupants.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it composes two remote focus-root branches into facial anatomy and then lets later eyes and visible or covered signs activate that image. It remains valid as an imagistic overlay anchored in both focus words and packet-backed context; downstream prose should never claim that the city noun lexically means a face.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The oath root can image beauty apportioned across a face, while the city root can image the clear opening between eyebrows.

activation_trace.role: Supplies facial beauty distributed across features and provides the face's internal apportionment.
Supplies the clear space between the eyebrows and locates a facial opening directly in the city root.
Supplies the eyes and changes the latent face from ornament into a seeing surface.
Supplies an outwardly visible sign and lets the witnessing surface also bear legible marks.
Supplies covering and creates the counteraction by which a visible civic face can be occluded.

changed_reading.before: The city is only a tract seen from outside.
changed_reading.after: The city can shimmer as a face whose features are apportioned, whose clear opening and eyes witness, and whose signs can either remain visible or be covered.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This outlier deliberately uses the packet's non-dominant mapping of the speech root to an image of smallness. It is valid as a scale-reversing activation anchored to the focus's apportionment and bounded-place mechanism, but it is not a claim that the contextual verb lexically means 'to be little'; downstream prose should label the reversal as a split-root counterimage.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The opening root can apportion and measure shares within the bounded city, giving later claims a scale on which they can be enlarged or diminished.

activation_trace.role: Supplies apportioned shares and gives the later boast a measure rather than accepting its scale.
Supplies a bounded field and contains the boast within a finite jurisdiction.
Supplies smallness from the non-dominant mapped root and reverses the asserted magnitude of the spoken claim.
Supplies abundant acquired wealth and establishes the scale that the counterimage contests.
Supplies piled mass and intensifies the abundance whose rhetorical size is being shrunk.

changed_reading.before: The oath precedes a straightforward boast about a very large expenditure.
changed_reading.after: The oath's scale can expose a reversal: what speech piles up as vast is bounded, apportioned, and branch-wise reduced to a small claim under examination.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is politically surprising because it activates the rare truce branch of the oath root together with the city root's armed-contest branch, then reads release and right-left division as pressure on that truce. Both anchors are focus-internal and context-supported, but the mechanism is form-distant; downstream prose should present it only as a possible armistice analogy, not as the direct morphology of the verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The verbal root at word 2 includes an armistice image, and the city root at word 4 includes combat with swords or sticks.

activation_trace.role: Supplies a truce or armistice and lets the negated oath construction carry a suspended-peace possibility.
Supplies armed contest with swords or sticks and makes the city a potentially contested ground.
Supplies removal of prohibition and introduces the legal release that can destabilize an armistice boundary.
Supplies the rightward side and forms one alignment within the contested-place analogy.
Supplies the leftward side and forms the opposed alignment that puts truce under pressure.

changed_reading.before: The opening is solely a devotional oath by a peaceful place.
changed_reading.after: A contained political analogy hears a truce poised over contested urban ground, with prohibition loosened and inhabitants eventually aligned into opposed sides.

strongest_changes: The immediate untying and oath-release images revise the stable city-oath into a reversible legal-spatial bind centered on the addressee's presence.
Counting, measure, asserted expenditure, piled wealth, and sight turn the opening into a public account rather than ceremonial praise of place.
Release, feeding, kinship, and dust-poverty make the bounded city's apportioned shares concrete civic obligations.
Body parts, bifurcating routes, reciprocal counsel, opposed sides, and final closure support coexisting civic-body, route-map, covenant, and sorting-enclosure readings.
summary.what_was_special: The focus inventories themselves were unusually generative: the oath root held oath, apportionment, divided thought, facial distribution, and truce, while the city root held boundary, residence, chest, facial opening, confusion, and combat. Context repeatedly activated those latent alternatives through unbinding, generation, anatomy, accounting, traversal, redistribution, reciprocity, and enclosure, so reducing the trace to one oath formula would erase the packet's strongest discoveries.
remaining_uncertainties: The force of the initial negation remains open among emphatic framing, genuine denial, interruption, suspension, and reversal.
The civic-body and route-map models depend on compositional scale analogies; the packet does not force the later body parts or paths to refer back to the city.
The communal-covenant model may redistribute an oath that grammatically remains the opening speaker's alone.
Non-dominant split-root activations and the truce, face, and combat branches should remain explicitly contained rather than promoted to lexical equations.
